A holiday company records the number of bedrooms in each property it lets; most properties have 2 or 3 bedrooms, but a handful of large villas have 8 or more. Which average best describes a 'typical' property, and why?

options.A: Mode, because the number of bedrooms is always a whole number
options.B: Median, because it is not affected by the few very large villas
options.C: Mean, because it uses every value in the data set
options.D: Range, because it shows how spread out the data are
